svg.aria-label: An isometric pull request machine on a bench. Parcels standing for pull requests leave an intake hopper on an indexing conveyor and pass under a review station whose stamp presses each one. 14 merged pull requests are stacked in the crate at the end of the belt and 23 wait under review in the holding tray. The dial on the station reads 38 % merged. By project: Symfony 14 merged, 2 under review; API Platform 0 merged, 8 under review; API Platform installer 0 merged, 2 under review; Caddy 0 merged, 8 under review; Ting 0 merged, 3 under review.
svg.title: 14 merged and 23 under review open source pull requests
